Food self-sufficiency and building-integrated urban agriculture: Lessons from Singapore
venue: SMU Economics and Statistics Working Paper
abstract: Singapore aims to achieve 30% food self-sufficiency by 2030, known as the 30-by-30 target, and this chapter reviews Singapore’s changing landscape for urban agriculture and its recent progress towards the 30-by-30 goal, highlighting key challenges such as land constraints, high production costs, and resource limitations. Building-integrated agriculture (BIA), which utilizes building surfaces such as rooftops, façades, and balconies for food production within urban environments, is examined as a potential way to increase self-sufficiency through a simulation. Despite the BIA’s potential, practical issues – including regulatory concerns and infrastructure limitations – must be addressed before it can be implemented at scale. Insights from Singapore’s experience offer valuable lessons for other dense, land-scarce cities around the globe in seeking to enhance local food and sustainable production and strengthen resilience against supply shocks and disruptions.
abstract_zh: 新加坡的目标是到2030年实现30%的粮食自给率，即“30-by-30”目标。本章回顾了新加坡城市农业不断变化的格局及其在实现30-by-30目标方面的最新进展，重点分析了土地约束、高昂的生产成本和资源限制等关键挑战。建筑一体化农业（BIA）利用屋顶、外立面和阳台等建筑表面，在城市环境中进行粮食生产，本章通过模拟考察了其提高粮食自给率的潜力。尽管BIA具有潜力，但在大规模实施之前，必须解决包括监管问题和基础设施限制在内的实际问题。新加坡的经验为其他人口稠密、土地稀缺的城市提供了宝贵的借鉴，有助于它们提升本地粮食和可持续生产能力，并增强应对供应冲击和中断的韧性。

title: Singapore as a sustainable city: Past, present and the future
venue: The Singapore Economy: Dynamism and Inclusion, book chapter
abstract: This paper outlines Singapore’s major sustainability challenges and its policy response in the areas of land use, transportation, waste management, water, and energy. We review the current and past Concept Plans from the perspective of sustainable land use and provide an overview of transportation policy in Singapore. We also examine Singapore’s policies to manage increasing wastes and review the four tap water management plan. Finally, we look at various initiatives by the government for sustainable use of energy. While Singapore has been successful in many ways in transforming itself into one of the most prosperous and sustainable cities in the world, there remain challenges to make the city even cleaner and greener for a better future. We discuss the opportunities that new technologies will bring about and the role that Singapore can play in building a sustainable city.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了新加坡在土地利用、交通、废弃物管理、水资源和能源领域面临的主要可持续发展挑战及其政策应对。我们从可持续土地利用的角度回顾了当前及过去的总体规划（Concept Plans），并概述了新加坡的交通政策。我们还考察了新加坡为应对日益增加的废弃物而采取的政策，并回顾了四项自来水管理计划。最后，我们考察了政府为实现能源可持续利用所采取的各类举措。尽管新加坡在将自身转变为世界上最繁荣、最可持续的城市之一方面取得了诸多成功，但要使这座城市变得更加清洁和绿色，以迎接更美好的未来，仍面临挑战。我们讨论了新技术带来的机遇，以及新加坡在建设可持续城市中可以发挥的作用。

Climate change and vulnerability to poverty: an empirical investigation in rural Indonesia
abstract: Scientists estimate that anthropogenic climate change leads to increased surface temperature, sea-level rise, more frequent and significant extreme weather and climate events, among others. In this study, we investigate how climate change can potentially change the vulnerability to poverty using a panel data set in Indonesia. We focus on the effect of drought and flood, two of the commonly observed disasters there. Our simulation results indicate that vulnerability to poverty may increase substantially as a result of climate change in Indonesia.
abstract_zh: 科学家估计，人为气候变化会导致地表温度升高、海平面上升，以及极端天气和气候事件更加频繁和严重等。在本研究中，我们利用印度尼西亚的面板数据，考察气候变化如何可能改变贫困脆弱性。我们重点关注干旱和洪水这两种当地常见的灾害的影响。模拟结果表明，气候变化可能使印度尼西亚的贫困脆弱性大幅上升。

title: Arrow-Fisher-Hanemann-Henry and Dixit-Pindyck option values under strategic interactions
abstract: We extend the Arrow-Fisher-Hanemann-Henry (AFHH) and Dixit-Pindyck (DP) option values to game situations. By reinterpreting the AFHH option value as a change in the surplus from conservation because of the prospect of future information, we deal with the conceptual difficulty associated with the AFHH option value in the presence of strategic interactions. We then introduce the DP option value into a game situation. We show that the equivalence between the expected value of information and the DP option value in the standard model does not hold under strategic interactions.
abstract_zh: 我们将Arrow-Fisher-Hanemann-Henry（AFHH）期权价值和Dixit-Pindyck（DP）期权价值扩展至博弈情境。通过将AFHH期权价值重新解释为由于未来信息的预期而导致的保护剩余变化，我们解决了在存在战略互动情况下AFHH期权价值所面临的概念性困难。随后，我们将DP期权价值引入博弈情境。我们证明，在标准模型中，信息的期望价值与DP期权价值之间的等价关系，在存在战略互动时并不成立。
